data.rationale: This species is renowned for its extraordinarily vivid and diverse plumage, featuring a striking combination of red, yellow, black, and a bare turquoise crown, visually representing its ability to generate mana of 'any color.' Its unique, almost otherworldly beauty and rarity in remote New Guinea forests evoke the feeling of a precious, magical creature vital to a diverse ecosystem, fitting its role as a versatile mana source.
